root_cause: The positive canonical live-contract fixture still modeled the pre-Build pricing page. After production-readback began requiring Build and the value/payback proof, the fixture itself failed before live production could be evaluated.
prevention_rule: Whenever the immutable live pricing contract gains a required commercial token, its positive fixture must be updated in the same lineage and continue to reject legacy commercial copy.

evidence.outcome: Positive pricing fixture contains Build and value/payback proof while the live contract still rejects Transform and annual-toggle copy.
